VALIDATION_FAILED.description: The request failed validation. Field-level codes are in `errors` (see validation_codes).

NOT_FOUND.description: The resource or route does not exist, or it is not yours.

METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.description: The route exists but not with this HTTP method (see the Allow header).

UNAUTHENTICATED.description: No session, or it expired (including a refused refresh). Go to the sign-in form.

INVALID_CREDENTIALS.description: Login failed: wrong email or password. The same answer whether or not the account exists.

MFA_CHALLENGE_INVALID.description: The MFA challenge is missing, expired or already used. Go back to the sign-in form.

MFA_CODE_INVALID.description: Wrong TOTP or recovery code. Stay on the form; it counts toward the login throttle.

PASSWORD_INCORRECT.description: The current password is wrong (disable MFA, delete account). Stay on the form.

TOKEN_INVALID.description: The verify-email or reset token is missing, expired or already used. The reason is not given.

CSRF_FAILED.description: Missing or wrong X-CSRF-Token, or a bad Origin. Fetch GET /auth/csrf again and retry once.

EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED.description: The action needs a verified email address.

MFA_ALREADY_ENABLED.description: MFA enrollment was started while MFA is already active.

MFA_NOT_ENABLED.description: MFA was turned off while it is not active.

RATE_LIMITED.description: Too many requests. Wait for the Retry-After header (seconds) before trying again.

FILE_TOO_LARGE.description: The file is larger than the per-file limit (see GET /limits).

QUOTA_EXCEEDED.description: The workspace storage quota is full. Delete files or ask the owner to raise it.

PERSONAL_WORKSPACE_UNDELETABLE.description: The personal workspace cannot be deleted. Only workspaces you created can be.

PRECONDITION_FAILED.description: Someone changed this since you loaded it (stale If-Match). Reload, then apply your change again.

PRECONDITION_REQUIRED.description: The If-Match header is missing on a PATCH that requires it (client bug).

DRAFT_INVALID.description: A run can't start from a draft that failed validation. The issues are in `errors`.

PLAN_HASH_MISMATCH.description: The plan changed since it was shown. Review it again, then approve.

INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION.description: The action isn't allowed in the run's current state (params.from, params.action).

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request (client bug).

BASE_VERSION_STALE.description: A newer workflow version exists. Reload the workflow, then map again from the latest version.

INTERNAL_ERROR.description: Unexpected server error. Show the correlation_id so support can find it.

NOT_IMPLEMENTED.description: Contract stub: the endpoint is documented but not implemented yet.

MISSING.description: A required field (or the whole body) is missing.

EXTRA_FORBIDDEN.description: A field that the endpoint does not accept was sent.

JSON_INVALID.description: The body is not valid JSON.

MODEL_ATTRIBUTES_TYPE.description: The body must be a JSON object.

STRING_TOO_SHORT.description: The text is too short (minimum in params.min_length).

PASSWORD_BREACHED.description: The new password is on the list of breached passwords (P5.1, NIST 800-63B). Ask for another one; length and any script are fine.

STRING_TOO_LONG.description: The text is too long (maximum in params.max_length).

STRING_PATTERN_MISMATCH.description: The text does not have the expected format (for example a 6-digit code).

LITERAL_ERROR.description: The value is not one of the allowed options (in params.expected).

UUID_PARSING.description: The id is not a valid UUID.

MFA_CODE_OR_RECOVERY_REQUIRED.description: Send exactly one of an authenticator code or a recovery code.

INT_FROM_FLOAT.description: A whole number is required, not a fraction.

GREATER_THAN.description: The number is too small (params.gt is the exclusive minimum).

GREATER_THAN_EQUAL.description: The number is too small (params.ge is the minimum).

LESS_THAN_EQUAL.description: The number is too large (params.le is the maximum).

TOO_SHORT.description: The list has too few items (params.min_length is the minimum).

TOO_LONG.description: The list has too many items (params.max_length is the maximum).

INVALID.description: The value is invalid (fallback for a check without its own code).

FILE_EMPTY.description: The uploaded file has no content.

FILE_SIZE_MISMATCH.description: The stored size differs from the size given at upload-intent.

FILE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED.description: The content is not a supported type, whatever the file extension says (checked by magic bytes).

FILE_CORRUPT.description: The file is damaged and cannot be read.

ZIP_TOO_MANY_MEMBERS.description: The ZIP has more files than allowed (25).

ZIP_TOO_LARGE.description: The ZIP's uncompressed size is over the limit (200 MiB).

ZIP_RATIO_EXCEEDED.description: The ZIP compresses more than 100:1 (zip bomb guard).

ZIP_UNSAFE_PATH.description: A file inside the ZIP has an absolute path or a '..' segment.

ZIP_SYMLINK.description: The ZIP contains a symbolic link.

ZIP_MEMBER_UNSUPPORTED.description: A file inside the ZIP is not a supported type.

OP_UNKNOWN.description: A node uses an operation that doesn't exist (params.operation).

OP_VERSION_INVALID.description: A node pins a version of the operation that doesn't exist (params.operation, params.version, params.known).

NODE_ID_DUPLICATE.description: Two nodes have the same id. The second one is reported (node_id).

NODE_UNKNOWN.description: An edge or workflow input/output points at a node that doesn't exist (params.node_id).

PORT_UNKNOWN.description: A port name doesn't exist on that node's operation (params.port, params.direction: input or output).

PORT_UNBOUND.description: A required input port of a node is fed by no edge and no workflow input (node_id, params.port).

PORT_BOUND_TWICE.description: An input port is fed more than once. The second binding is reported (node_id, params.port).

EDGE_DUPLICATE.description: The same edge appears twice. The second one is reported.

DAG_CYCLE.description: The steps form a loop, so the workflow can never finish (params.nodes: the nodes on the loop).

PORT_TYPE_MISMATCH.description: A port receives a different artifact type than it accepts. There is no implicit conversion (node_id, params.port, params.expected, params.got).

PARAM_INVALID.description: A node parameter breaks the operation's parameter schema (node_id, params.field, params.rule: the JSON Schema keyword, such as required, type, enum or pattern).

LIMIT_NODES.description: The workflow has too many steps (params.limit, params.actual).

LIMIT_DEPTH.description: The longest chain of steps is too long (params.limit, params.actual: nodes on the longest path).

LIMIT_FAN_IN.description: Too many edges go into one step (node_id, params.limit, params.actual).

LIMIT_FAN_OUT.description: Too many edges leave one step (node_id, params.limit, params.actual).

LIMIT_FILES.description: More files than the resource policy allows: workflow inputs (path inputs) or the files given (path files) (params.limit, params.actual).

LIMIT_FILE_SIZE.description: A file is larger than the resource policy allows (path files/<i>, params.limit, params.actual in bytes).

NODE_FAILED.description: A node's operation failed (node_id; params.error is the operation's own code, with its params; params.attempts is how many times it ran, up to 3 for a transient error). In a PARTIAL run this is a warning.

NODE_SKIPPED.description: A node didn't run because a required input came from a node that failed or was skipped (node_id, params.port, params.source).

OUTPUT_MISSING.description: A workflow output wasn't produced, so the run FAILED (path outputs/<i>, params.output).

LOW_CONFIDENCE.description: An operation isn't sure of its result, for example a guessed key column. Under the review policy the run stops as NEEDS_REVIEW (node_id, path nodes/<i>/<port>).

INPUT_TYPE_MISMATCH.description: Replay: a new file is a different kind of artifact from the one the workflow version expects, so the run stops as NEEDS_REVIEW (path inputs/<i>, params.input, params.expected, params.actual).

INPUT_COLUMNS_MISSING.description: Replay: a new file lacks columns the workflow version expects, so the run stops as NEEDS_REVIEW (path inputs/<i>, params.input, params.missing). Extra columns are fine.

KEY_NOT_FOUND.description: Draft warning: no column is in both files and unique in both, so the key is left for the user to pick (path nodes/<i>/params/key).

KEY_AMBIGUOUS.description: Draft warning: several columns could be the key, so it is left for the user to pick (path nodes/<i>/params/key, params.candidates).

VALUE_NOT_FOUND.description: Draft warning: no numeric column is in both files, so the value to compare is left for the user to pick (path nodes/<i>/params/value).

VALUE_AMBIGUOUS.description: Draft warning: several numeric columns could be the value, so it is left for the user to pick (path nodes/<i>/params/value, params.candidates).

COLUMNS_DIFFER.description: Draft warning (merge): a file's columns are not the first file's, so merging it may leave gaps (path inputs/<i>, params.file, params.missing, params.extra).
